items.title: Fix static_settle vertical jitter at rest
items.detail: Fails ~1 in 3 cold starts (up to 1.375 vs 0.5): the parked chassis gets periodic ~0.8 stud/s vertical kicks on its suspension. RollingDrag 1.0 did not fix it (it acts on the look axis). physics-tuner: spring/contact at rest in CarPhysics, through /car-loop.
